title: Mobile Application Management (MAM) App Protection Policies for BYOD (Microsoft 365 Apps)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (MAM-without-enrollment App Protection Policies for M365 apps on unenrolled BYOD + app config + CA grant; multi-component within Intune).
Foundational MAM/APP product (distinct from COD/BYOD MDM enrollment). version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Protect corporate data in mobile apps — without managing the whole personal device
problem: Employees want to use Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint on their own phones, and IT wants the data safe — but enrolling personal devices into full MDM is intrusive and slows adoption. Mobile Application Management (MAM) with App Protection Policies is the answer: protect corporate data inside the Microsoft 365 apps (encryption, copy/paste and save-as limits, PIN, selective wipe) on unenrolled BYOD devices, without touching the rest of the phone. This solution gives you a repeatable way to stand up App Protection Policies for BYOD in Microsoft Intune and enforce them with Conditional Access.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how MAM / App Protection Policies (MAM-without-enrollment) work, the data-protection controls (encryption, cut/copy/paste, save-as, PIN, selective wipe), app configuration, and how Conditional Access enforces 'require approved app / app protection policy'.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune with App Protection, Entra ID + Conditional Access, the Microsoft 365 mobile apps, licensing, target user groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: create App Protection Policies for iOS and Android, set data-protection and access settings, add app configuration, enforce with a Conditional Access app-protection grant, validate on unenrolled BYOD, then pilot and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — App Protection Policy discovery, per-user/app protection-status validation, a coverage and enforcement report, safe remediation of gaps, and a MAM scope-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to stand up App Protection Policies for BYOD in Microsoft Intune — protect corporate data inside the Microsoft 365 apps on unenrolled personal devices, enforced with Conditional Access, without full device management. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
